Analyze the narrative of this illustration and identify the single most critical moment of fate within the story.

[Scene Construction]

- Recreate that decisive moment as a new illustration

- The scene should feel candid and unposed — as if captured accidentally by a camera

- The subject is caught mid-action, unaware of being observed

- The composition is slightly off-balance, as if the photographer moved suddenly

[Depth & Lens]

- Place an out-of-focus object in the foreground close to the lens — a branch, fabric, foliage, architectural element, or any environmental object native to the scene

- Human hands or body parts must never appear in the foreground

- This foreground element creates strong depth separation

- Apply shallow depth of field: the focal point is sharp, everything else falls into natural bokeh

- Slight motion blur on peripheral elements suggests a fleeting moment

[Imperfection]

- The framing is imperfect — subject may be slightly off-center or partially cropped

- Focus is not perfectly locked — the sharpest point is close but not clinical

- The image feels like it was taken one second before or after the "perfect" shot

[Atmosphere]

- The emotional weight of the story's turning point must be felt in the image

- Light and shadow reflect the tension of the moment

- Preserve the original art style and color palette of the source illustration

Generate a hyper-cinematic, photorealistic portrait using the face from the reference image. The figure stands alone beneath a {argument name="lighting" default="single glowing streetlight"} in a torrential night rain. Rain cascades visibly with heavy droplets splashing off the pavement. The lamp casts a warm amber glow, spotlighting the subject as the surroundings dissolve into deep shadows. The wet ground mirrors the golden light in liquid reflections. Frame the shot from a slightly low, centered angle for a bold, film-noir look. The subject wears a {argument name="outfit" default="sleek dark coat or jacket"}, soaked through, water streaming down fabric and hair. Expression: composed, intense, magnetic. Style: cinematic contrast, volumetric rain shafts, Hollywood production quality, ultra-realistic detail, rich atmospheric depth.

[Person] Refer to Image 1 and Image 2.

[Pose and Expression]

Standing in a hot air balloon basket, naturally turning the body diagonally to look far to the left. One hand rests lightly on the inside of the basket's railing, looking into the distance with a calm, subtle, and wistful expression as if enjoying the fresh early morning air.

[Attire]

A cozy, soft-textured drop-shoulder {argument name="knit color" default="ivory"} round-neck knit sweater. Silver sparkling beads and tassel decorations along the right bottom slit of the sweater provide a glamorous point, paired with clean white pants. Simple mini earrings are worn.

[Hair and Makeup]

A calm, {argument name="hair style" default="bright medium long hair"} with natural volume. The hair flows naturally over the shoulders and front without special styling, lightly swaying in the morning breeze. The makeup is very clear and natural, matching the soft morning sunlight with transparent skin expression and calm nude-toned lips. Clean black nail art is on the fingernails.

[Lighting]

Soft, warm natural sunlight from the late dawn, rising low near the horizon just after sunrise, shines from the left. This subtle morning sun transparently illuminates the cozy surface texture of the {argument name="knit color" default="ivory"} sweater and creates soft shadows along the right cheek and shoulder line, adding three-dimensionality.

[Texture and Color Mood]

Overall, tone-on-tone clothing of soft white, cream, and beige colors harmonizes with the pastel-toned morning sky to create a peaceful and romantic mood. The dense, soft wool texture of the knit contrasts with the rough rattan weave of the basket and the brilliant crystal bead textures at the bottom.

[Technical Specs]

Shot using an f/4.0 aperture, 1/500s shutter speed, ISO 100, and a 28mm wide-angle lens. A front eye-level angle capturing the person up to the thighs inside the basket while balancing the vast land and sky behind. Focus is on the subject, while the deep depth of field captures the distant rock formations and numerous balloons clearly.

[Background]

A vast panoramic view of {argument name="location" default="Cappadocia"} with exotic rock formations and canyons. In the clear blue morning sky with orange sunrise afterglow, dozens of hot air balloons of various colors and patterns float leisurely, creating a fairy-tale landscape.

[Signature] A small Threads logo in the bottom right, with "CHAse" written in small white cursive above it like a signature.

Please devise {argument name="count" default="4"} types of Wagashi (Japanese sweets) themed after {argument name="motif" default="this character"} and create an advertising shot of them arranged on a tray. Please use a {argument name="aspect ratio" default="3:4"} vertical aspect ratio.

[The Shopkeeper from Another World]
A tea shop where Big Ben is visible.

{argument name="character name" default="Lucielle"}, a girl of the Moon Rabbit race from Floria Bell, the Land of Flower Crowns, was sucked into a silver teapot that cracked during a full moon tea party, and found herself standing in a plaza in {argument name="location" default="London"}.

She only cried in distress on the first day; now she runs a tea and cake stall on the street where the clock tower is visible.

Tea with the scent of flowers, scones topped with strawberries, and magical syrups in small bottles. In the back, tea sets that fell with her from her original world are lined up.

The people holding up their smartphones are likely photographing not just the sweets, but the small miracle that has strayed into this city.

I want to see a hand-drawn style illustration of a beautiful {argument name="character" default="cat-eared girl"} with {argument name="hair color" default="rainbow-colored"} hair and a {argument name="animal" default="gentle cat"}, using very few brushstrokes. Can you generate a sharp digital illustration with an oil-painting feel similar to Midjourney?

Hyper-realistic high-end fashion magazine photography, cinematic indoor lighting, Japanese film atmosphere, 8K RAW ultra-fine details, slight film grain, Kodak Portra 400 tones. A mature {argument name="ethnicity" default="mixed-race Asian"} woman, full body-to-head ratio in frame, exquisite and three-dimensional features, gentle and slightly shy gaze, looking at the camera, high nose bridge, natural and soft lips, beautiful collarbone and jawline, long straight black hair falling naturally. Skin is delicate and smooth, healthy and pinkish, with a slight hydrated reflection, clearly visible fine pores, natural texture, creamy highlights, and a slight subcutaneous translucency. Makeup is transparent and clean, light matte base with a subtle glow, long lashes, natural light pink to peach gradient lip color. Tall and slender figure, balanced proportions, distinctly tightened waist, clear transition between pelvis and hips, rounded and voluminous buttocks, long legs, forming a clear and continuous elegant S-curve from shoulders to hips. Clothing: {argument name="clothing" default="Black lightweight chiffon qipao-collar camisole, V-neckline, scattered with white and light pink peony floral prints; slim-fit high-waisted short skirt; black patent leather pointed-toe slingback stilettos with mirror-like highlights"}. Scene: {argument name="scene" default="Inside a light rail/tram/bus during the day, with large windows, wooden benches, metal handrails, billboards, and city buildings outside the window"}. Soft natural side light passes through the window, creating softened highlights, slight rim light, delicate shadow transitions, and a sense of atmosphere. Ultra-low angle shot, 80mm lens, F1.8 aperture, vertical 3:4 composition, head fully in frame, body visible down to calves or ankles, subject located from bottom right to center. Subject is clear and sharp, background slightly blurred, colors vibrant yet controlled. Overall image is high-end, restrained, elegant, fashionable, with a strong magazine poster feel.

I want to see a hand-drawn style illustration of a beautiful {argument name="subject" default="cat-eared girl"} with {argument name="hair color" default="rainbow-colored"} hair, with very few brushstrokes that look almost like an abstract painting. Can you generate a sharp digital illustration that looks like an {argument name="style" default="oil painting in the style of Midjourney"}?

Use the character from the reference image as the base design to depict '{argument name="scene" default="the moment a reincarnated anime character is working normally as a receptionist at an adventurer's guild in another world"}.' Accurately maintain the character's anime illustration atmosphere. Maintain the impression of the character's face, hairstyle, hair color, eyes, ears, silhouette, body proportions, and expression. Never break the character's identity. Do not turn them into a different person or a live-action human. Maintain the anime illustration style for the character part. The setting is {argument name="location" default="the headquarters of a major city guild in a fantasy world"}. The background is a high-quality fantasy space as if rendered in {argument name="engine" default="Unreal Engine 5"}. Realistic-leaning background depiction. A lived-in other-world space. Not too clean. Do not make it look like concept art or an official game visual. Naturally place elements in the background such as a massive quest board, wooden counter, request forms, maps, weapon racks, adventurers in leather armor, magic lanterns, stone walls, a tavern space, vaulted ceilings, second-floor corridors, luggage, barrels, and miscellaneous supplies. The composition is first-person perspective (POV). The viewer is an adventurer visiting the guild. Naturally frame elements in the foreground like the adventurer's arms, hands, request forms, adventurer cards, reward bags, maps, drinks, and luggage. The POV person performs natural actions interacting with the receptionist, such as trying to receive a request, holding out an adventurer card, reaching for a reward bag, peering at a map, or leaning on the counter. The anime character as the receptionist performs natural 'working' actions like handing over a request, spreading a map to explain, returning an adventurer card, handing over a reward bag, guiding a beginner quest, congratulating a rank up, or looking slightly sleepy while working. Importance: The character themselves does not see being an other-world receptionist as special, and the surrounding adventurers accept it as a normal daily occurrence. Add a game UI-style overlay showing adventurer rank, quest info, money, party info, notifications, and a mini-map naturally. The UI content should be naturally generated by the AI and not fixed. The UI is not the protagonist; it only reinforces the interaction. Focus on a strangely realistic atmosphere where the anime character merges naturally with the fantasy world. Do not make it look like a movie poster. No excessive cinematic direction. No overly perfect compositions. Avoid AI-specific glossy rendering. Do not overload with info. Prioritize a sense of daily life and coincidence, like 'a moment witnessed by chance in a fantasy world' rather than a 'game event screenshot.' high quality anime character, UE5 fantasy environment, POV shot, guild receptionist, natural interaction, fantasy daily life, weirdly realistic atmosphere

High-angle overhead perspective, authentic street photography style. A giant black rounded-corner smartphone lies flat on a rough grey concrete floor, appearing as a physical object with thickness, bezels, and shadows, in a vertical 3:4 composition. The phone screen displays the QQ Music interface with a deep dark green UI, highlighted green buttons, and a progress bar, appearing clear and realistic with Chinese music player elements.

A gentle and beautiful young Chinese woman stands on the giant phone screen like a dreamlike figure within a music panel. She has an elegant Oriental beauty with soft, refined features, fair clean skin, subtle natural makeup, and a gentle, quiet gaze looking slightly up at the camera. Her black long hair is styled in a loose, elegant half-tie or low bun with minor natural wisps, accessorized with delicate earrings and a thin necklace. She wears a {argument name="dress color" default="purple"} long dress made of light gauze, flowing in layers with natural folds, a sheer shawl, thin straps, and small floral decorations. The overall style is romantic, gentle, Oriental, and ethereal while maintaining a realistic photographic texture.

Phone screen details: The top displays the time 13:14, with signal, battery, and loop icons on the top right. In the center is a square album cover featuring a purple-blue twilight sky, clouds, railings, and distant character silhouettes, creating a melancholic and romantic atmosphere with faint handwritten Chinese artistic calligraphy. The song info area clearly shows the Chinese title "{argument name="song title" default="Extra Explanation"}" and the singer "{argument name="singer name" default="Vae"}". Below are QQ Music style tag buttons: VIP, SQ, Dolby, Sound Effect Off, and Video. A lyric line reads "Our relationship had some issues back then." At the bottom is a green progress bar showing 01:53 and 04:21, with a green circular pause button in the middle flanked by previous, next, shuffle, and list icons, with "QQ Music" on the bottom right.

To the right on the ground sits a dark burgundy leather handbag with metal buckles, zippers, straps, and vintage hardware details. The bottom edge of the frame reveals the photographer's brown shoes and dark trousers, enhancing the first-person overhead perspective. A black glass door frame or building edge is visible in the top right. The overall lighting is soft and natural, with realistic photographic quality, clear details, high-end fashion magazine style, accurate scale between the giant phone and the person, precise perspective, and natural shadows, making the image clean and sophisticated.

Create a digital graphic where the word "{argument name="masked text" default="FAITH"}" is rendered in large, bold, sans-serif capital letters. The letters serve as a mask revealing a detailed portrait of a {argument name="subject" default="young woman with freckles, green eyes, and messy brown hair"} inside the text. She has a serene, soft expression. Behind her inside the letters, show a warm {argument name="accent color" default="lavender"} glow with soft-focus flowers. Set the entire text against a solid lavender-purple background with a subtle drop shadow on the letters to give a 3D effect. Use a double exposure or text-masking technique. Typography should be bold, capitalized sans-serif. Lighting should be warm, calm, and high-contrast in shades of lavender, purple, and violet. Overall layout: clean and minimalist with a flat background.

Photo Of Me, Wearing A {argument name="outfit" default="Black Zip-up Jacket, Black Pants And Black Boots"}, Sitting Relaxed And Reclined On A {argument name="furniture" default="Modern Thin Metal-frame Chair"} In A Minimalist Studio. He Is Leaning Back With Legs Stretched Forward, One Hand Resting On The Chair Arm, The Other On His Thigh, Looking To The Side With A Calm Expression, Dramatic Full-scene {argument name="lighting" default="Red Lighting"}, Entire Background And Floor Bathed In Intense Saturated Red Color, High Contrast, Cinematic Studio Portrait, Smooth Seamless Red Backdrop, Moody Atmosphere, Fashion Photography Style, Sharp Details, Professional Lighting

Create an ultra-realistic lifestyle fashion collage featuring {argument name="character description" default="a beautiful young woman with long brown hair in a loose side braid"} in a wide open green park during golden hour sunset. Use a warm cinematic natural-light look with soft sun flare, shallow depth of field, lush grass, leafy trees, and an aesthetic Korean casual fashion vibe. The woman wears {argument name="shirt" default="a deep burgundy oversized button-up shirt"}, {argument name="pants" default="light blue wide-leg denim jeans"}, white sneakers, and a brown leather crossbody shoulder bag. Compose a square 1:1 collage with exactly 5 photo panels: 1) top-left large panel, she sits cross-legged on a beige gingham picnic blanket reading an open book, with another closed book nearby; 2) top-right panel, she walks along a curving park path at sunset with the bag on her shoulder; 3) bottom-left panel, side profile close-up as she holds a small glass jar bouquet of wildflowers; 4) bottom-center panel, medium close-up as she raises a small vintage compact camera to take a photo; 5) bottom-right panel, rear three-quarter view as she stands on a grassy hill looking toward a distant city skyline under a glowing sunset. Keep the styling consistent across all panels: same outfit, same bag, same braided hairstyle, same warm golden-hour park environment. Faces should be softly obscured or out of focus rather than detailed. Photorealistic DSLR quality, natural skin and fabric texture, dreamy editorial lifestyle mood, no text, no watermark, no extra people.

Create a cheerful full-body photorealistic/3D hybrid portrait in a sunny park: a young woman with {argument name="hair style" default="shoulder-length wavy black hair"}, expressive eyes, a warm smile, and an adorable face stands confidently in a casual stylish pose beside a life-size Tom Cat character from Tom and Jerry. Her face should be softly anonymized/blurred, while the rest of the scene remains sharp. She wears exactly 4 visible outfit pieces: a cozy black crewneck sweater with a large colorful Tom Cat cartoon print on the front, baggy high-waisted blue jeans, white Converse-style low-top sneakers, and no visible accessories. Tom is a tall gray-blue anthropomorphic cat mascot with soft plush-like fur, a white belly and paws, pink inner ears, green-yellow eyes, black eyebrows, whiskers, and a friendly smile; he stands to her right with one arm around her shoulders and the other hand resting on his hip, tail curved behind him. The woman stands with one arm relaxed at her side and the other around Tom’s back/shoulder area. Use a square 1:1 composition, full-body framing, eye-level camera, shallow depth of field, warm golden daylight, soft bokeh trees, a paved park path, green grass, distant benches, and a black lamppost in the background. Make the image polished, cute, wholesome, high-resolution, and cinematic, with realistic fabric folds, denim texture, sneaker details, and fluffy character fur. Avoid extra characters, logos beyond the Tom print, text, watermarks, or cropped feet.

Create a hyper-realistic full-body vertical fashion editorial portrait in a 9:16 aspect ratio, shot like a Vogue luxury streetwear café spread. The subject is a {argument name="character description" default="young woman with long dark brown hair"} sitting elegantly on a chair beside a large floor-to-ceiling glass window in a stylish modern city café. She is posed with one leg crossed over the other, her right elbow resting near her body with her hand touching her chin in a thoughtful fashion-model pose, and her left hand relaxed on the edge of a small round marble café table. Her face should be softly anonymized with a realistic rectangular blur/mask while preserving natural hair, head shape, and body proportions. Outfit: oversized black tailored blazer with subtle embroidered detailing on the sleeves, black luxury logo hoodie underneath, loose dark washed black jeans with a small distressed rip at one knee, and chunky black-white-beige designer sneakers. On the table to her right are exactly 2 visible items: a tall latte in a clear glass on a saucer and a beige monogram luxury handbag with black trim and gold hardware. The café interior includes exactly 4 background people, softly blurred: two seated customers on the right side, one barista/person working at the counter, and one person farther back near the counter. Include a softly blurred menu board, coffee equipment, warm pendant lights, pale tile floor, marble tabletop, black table base, and brown café chairs. Through the glass window on the left, show a rainy or overcast urban street with muted buildings, sidewalk reflections, and soft city blur. Use natural window light mixed with warm indoor café lighting, shallow depth of field, realistic lens perspective, high-end editorial color grading, crisp clothing textures, 8K detail, vertical composition, full-body framing from head to shoes. Avoid extra text, logos that are too legible, distorted hands, extra limbs, duplicate cups, or additional table objects.

Create a square 1:1 grainy retro vintage fashion photograph of a {argument name="subject" default="young woman"} standing outdoors in front of a sunlit beige stucco wall covered with flowering vines. She wears a loose ivory-white wool short-sleeve T-shirt and matching relaxed white pants with a gathered elastic waist, plus a shiny silver luxury formal wristwatch. Her hair is {argument name="hair style" default="voluminous dark brown 1990s movie baddie waves"}, wind-swept and glamorous. Pose her facing the camera: one hand lifted to the side of her head, the other hand gently plucking or holding one purple flower from the vine. Surround her with abundant bougainvillea-like blossoms in purple, pink, and magenta with deep green leaves, especially along the left side and upper background. Use warm harsh afternoon sunlight with strong natural shadows on the wall, shallow depth of field, slightly soft focus, analog film grain, muted vintage colors, and candid editorial styling. The face should be intentionally anonymized with a centered soft rectangular blur/mosaic over the facial features while the rest of the image remains detailed. No text, no watermark, no extra people.

Goal: Create a polished anime-style character sheet for {argument name="character name" default="Angie"}, a dark fantasy sword angel girl, on a clean white studio background.

Canvas: Wide horizontal character design board, approximately 16:9, with lots of white space and small handwritten annotation labels. Render in high-detail 3D/anime concept art style with soft shadows under each pose.

Character design: A stoic, ominous, poised young female warrior called {argument name="character name" default="Angie"}. She has short black bobbed hair, glowing amber eyes, pale skin, and a shadowed face under a red hood. She wears a red-and-cream gothic hooded dress with black leather sleeves, belts, buckles, ruffled trim, fingerless gloves, chunky black boots with red soles, and twin large black feathered wings. Her signature weapon is a massive dark sword, taller than her body, with a broad blade, jagged sawlike spine, circular bronze insets, and a wrapped handle.

Top-left info card: Add a thin black rectangular box with four typed lines exactly formatted like a character sheet: NAME: {argument name="character name" default="Angie"}; ROLE: {argument name="role" default="Dark Sword Angel"}; CORE MOOD: {argument name="core mood" default="Stoic, ominous, poised"}; VISUAL SIGNATURE: {argument name="visual signature" default="Twin black wings, red hood, giant dark sword, glowing amber eyes"}.

Layout and visible element counts: Include exactly 1 large central hero pose: full-body three-quarter view, standing confidently, sword held upright at her side, wings spread behind her. Include exactly 3 turnaround views on the left labeled Neutral, Back, and Profile. Include exactly 5 action pose studies on the right labeled Seated, Leaning, Crouching, Top-Down, and Low-Angle. Include exactly 3 black silhouette studies at bottom-left, showing different wing-and-sword readable shapes. Include exactly 4 expression-study head portraits at bottom-center, all hooded with subtle variations in stoic amber-eyed expressions. Include exactly 6 detail-study panels along the bottom-right: hooded face close-up, back hair close-up, black wing feathers, sword blade detail, dress/belt/skirt detail, and gloved hand detail.

Visual style: Premium game/anime character design sheet, crisp linework, cinematic muted palette of red, black, cream, bronze, and amber, realistic fabric and leather textures, feather detail, subtle ambient occlusion, no background scenery. Use elegant cursive handwritten labels for pose and study captions, while the info card uses clean serif type.

Constraints: Keep the whole board readable as a single professional character reference sheet. Do not add extra characters, extra poses, logos, watermarks, or unrelated props.

Create a photorealistic premium handmade collectible doll portrait in a warm studio macro setup. The subject is a miniature doll version of {argument name="character name" default="a South Asian woman"}, with a slightly oversized head and delicate handmade proportions, standing beside and hugging an enormous bitten wedge of watermelon that is taller than her torso. Preserve the doll-like realism: long thick wavy {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown hair"} parted in the center, cascading down her back; tiny realistic hands and bare feet; glossy blue-painted fingernails and toenails; gold earrings, necklace, bangles, anklets, and intricate henna-like details. Dress her in a traditional {argument name="outfit color" default="burnt orange"} South Asian embroidered outfit with a long dupatta being gently pinched and lifted by a large human hand entering from the upper left; the fabric has ornate gold trim, small floral embroidery, and a premium textile sheen. The face should be obscured by a plain centered square censor block in a medium brown skin-tone color, covering the facial features completely while leaving hair, jewelry, clothing, and pose visible. Compose the scene as a close-up vertical image with the doll on the left-center and the watermelon wedge on the right, its red juicy flesh facing camera, pale rind and mottled green skin visible, with multiple bite marks and wet juice droplets. The doll’s right hand presses into the watermelon flesh and her left arm wraps around it. Add red watermelon juice splashes, puddles, and small droplets on the cream tabletop at the base. Use shallow depth of field, soft golden-hour lighting, warm beige background, realistic scale contrast between the giant human fingers, tiny doll, and oversized fruit, crisp textures in hair strands, embroidery, wet fruit pulp, and skin. Avoid text, logos, watermarks, extra characters, or additional props.

Goal: Create a high-fashion editorial triptych featuring exactly 3 faceless female portrait panels side by side, shot like a luxury magazine campaign.

Canvas: Wide horizontal 16:9 image, clean studio lighting, sharp professional photography, waist-up portraits, no text or watermark.

Layout: Split the canvas into exactly 3 equal vertical panels with narrow borders. Each panel has a large elongated oval/arched backdrop behind the model, using warm metallic and jewel-tone colors.

Subjects: Panel 1 shows {argument name="left model outfit" default="a woman in an emerald green textured embroidered jacket with gold detailing"}, short tousled dark bob haircut, turned slightly in profile, gold earrings, green and gold background. Panel 2 shows {argument name="center model outfit" default="a woman in a coral satin blouse tucked into high-waisted cream trousers"}, voluminous curly dark hair, one hand raised near her chin, coral and cream arched background. Panel 3 shows {argument name="right model outfit" default="a woman in a cream double-breasted blazer with gold buttons"}, slicked-back shoulder-length hair, arms crossed, bold gold chain necklace, gold bracelet and rings, ivory and gold arched background.

Face treatment: All 3 faces are intentionally anonymized with smooth centered rectangular blur blocks in a natural skin-tone gradient, covering facial features completely while leaving hair, neck, clothing, jewelry, and pose visible.

Visual style: Luxe editorial fashion photography, glossy fabrics, rich color blocking, soft shadows, elegant gold accents, realistic skin and hair detail outside the blurred face areas, polished studio composition, premium advertising aesthetic.

Constraints: Use exactly 3 models, exactly 3 vertical panels, exactly 3 blurred face rectangles, no readable text, no logos, no extra people, no full-body framing.

Create an ultra-realistic premium handmade miniature figurine portrait of {argument name="character name" default="the person in the identity reference"}, preserving the exact facial resemblance, facial proportions, eye shape and spacing, nose, mouth, jawline, hairstyle, expression, and natural details. Show the tiny full-body figurine leaning against and partly climbing into one large cut wedge of watermelon. The figurine wears a dark navy tailored suit with matching trousers, glossy black dress shoes, and a dark shirt; the fabric is slightly wet and dotted with visible watermelon pulp and juice droplets. One hand is pressed into the red watermelon flesh, the other arm is near the rind, and one leg is braced on the tabletop for balance. A real human hand enters from the upper left, thumb and fingers gently pinching the miniature by the back/shoulder area to emphasize scale. The watermelon wedge is oversized compared with the figure, with vivid red juicy flesh, pale green-white rind, dark green striped outer skin, bite-like gouged texture, seeds/pulp pieces, and juice dripping onto a light wooden surface. Use warm studio macro photography, shallow depth of field, soft beige background, crisp focus on the miniature, hand, and watermelon texture, realistic skin pores on the fingers, glossy highlights on wet fruit and shoes, premium handcrafted collectible quality, vertical composition, no text, no watermark.

Goal: Create a highly polished pastel product advertisement photo for a fictional gashapon toy line featuring {argument name="character name" default="NOZOMU"}, designed like a collectible capsule figure display.

Canvas: Square 1:1 image, high-resolution commercial product photography with soft studio lighting, shallow depth of field, glossy reflections, and a cute teal, white, lavender, and pale pink palette.

Main subject: Center foreground shows one chibi anime capsule figure standing on a transparent round display base labeled “NOZOMU.” The figure is a small girl with long dark teal hair, large teal eyes, a cheerful open-mouth smile, and a white bear-ear hoodie with teal bear ears. She wears a teal oversized jacket over a white frilly dress, teal ribbons, tiny bear charms, white socks, and white sneakers. Her right hand lifts the edge of the hood, and her left arm is slightly out to the side. The base is clear acrylic with teal trim, decorative white scrollwork, a small bow motif, and the character name on the front.

Background and props: Place the figure in front of a transparent capsule vending machine filled with pastel capsules. Include exactly 9 visible capsule balls: 3 teal capsules, 2 lavender capsules, 2 white capsules, 1 pale blue capsule, and 1 pale pink capsule. The machine has a teal coin panel and a white dial, with small Japanese-style coin-insertion signage. On the right foreground, place exactly 2 large empty transparent capsule halves, slightly open and reflective. On the lower left, place exactly 1 mini brochure/card showing the same character artwork and the text “NOZOMU Mini Collection.” On the lower right, place exactly 1 clear plastic accessory bag containing small teal-and-white toy parts: a tiny bear-face charm, teal ribbon-like pieces, and small white accessories.

Left vending-machine sign: Add a rounded white sign with teal text at upper left. It must read “NOZOMU” in large letters, then “Capsule Figure” and “Mini Collection.” Include two teal rounded labels: one says “全5種” and one says “1回 400円.” Decorate the sign with small pale stars and soft pastel shapes.

Right collection board: Add a large rectangular collection lineup board on the right side with teal border and rounded corners.
